recommendation: Keep the external-repo audit commit as-is for core reconciliation. Future corrections to the extension definition should be made in HL7/fhir-extensions; core should only be changed if FHIR-I separately decides to add or revise narrative references to that external extension.
issue_request: FHIR-37456 asked how servers should represent _include/_revinclude search parameters in CapabilityStatement when the underlying SearchParameter is not supported as a standalone search. The Published/Persuasive with Modification resolution was to create a search-parameter-use extension that can declare standalone, _include, and _revinclude use contexts.
initial_application: The linked Zulip thread established the gap, FHIR-I minutes on 2022-05-23 recorded the Persuasive with Modification vote, and Jira later pointed to PR #2137. Core commits f0c782cad89d078ce4fb5ea189c4de4018010b52 and ff8e78aad41fd7a2f452b2a1639a2028b216e3b2 added and corrected source/capabilitystatement/structuredefinition-extension-capabilitystatement-search-parameter-use.xml before merge 12cba418a5cc3eb2ab3e04460c1887b95718f1e4.
additional_context: CapabilityStatement and SearchParameter remain active current-build resources in source/fhir.ini, and the current CapabilityStatement StructureDefinition still defines searchInclude, searchRevInclude, and searchParam. However, commit dd468d4f1799dd79819315b211588ef1cf4586e0 removed extension definitions from the R5 core source, leaving only the retained OID registry entry in core. The current FHIR Extension Pack source defines capabilitystatement-search-parameter-use with the approved canonical, context, and allow-standalone/allow-include/allow-revinclude slices.
reconciliation: No core source was changed. The requested artifact already exists in /home/jmandel/work/fhir-extensions, which is outside the HL7/fhir checkout for this run; adding a duplicate StructureDefinition back to core would conflict with the current extension-pack ownership model.
